nodes.label: index-ai Specification 1.0-rc2
nodes.description: The full normative specification text (single source of truth).

content.llm_summary: The index-ai open specification proposal v1.0-rc2: discovery profiles, Level 1 AI Manifest, Level 2 Agent View, Level 3 Query Interface (MCP), conformance, security, and governance. Request for comments until 2026-08-26.

Step-by-step quickstart: publish the AI Manifest (canonical or scoped discovery), expose clean text endpoints, build the Agent Index, and run the reference validator. Partial conformance is valid to ship.

nodes.label: index-ai vs llms.txt
nodes.description: Feature-by-feature comparison against the llms.txt convention.

content.llm_summary: Comparison of index-ai and llms.txt across format, verification, budget signal, structure, query interface, and policy. index-ai is additive: it coexists with llms.txt and robots.txt.
Changelog of the index-ai project: 1.0-rc2 second public release (2026-08-12), 1.0-rc1 first public release, plus the internal 0.x history. Published versions are immutable.
